title: Track Guide Long Beach Street Circuit Toyota GR86 iRacing

corners.label: T1
corners.braking: brake before 300 marker, full brake until turn-in at 100 board
corners.line: turn-in at 100 board, apex at inside curb, full throttle exit
corners.exit: full throttle, stay close to outside wall
corners.mistakes: don't take too much curb, don't cross pit lane exit line

corners.label: T2
corners.braking: brake crossing yellow line, 70% brake pressure to inside curb
corners.line: get close to left wall, apex at inside curb
corners.exit: full throttle, stay close to inside wall
corners.mistakes: don't cut too much inside curb

corners.label: T4
corners.braking: tap brake at markers on left of wall, 10% brake

corners.label: T4
corners.braking: tap brake to 10% at markers, off brake before curb

corners.label: T5
corners.braking: brake to 25% at discolorations, off brake before curb
corners.line: cut curb, left side tires on main curb

corners.label: T6
corners.braking: brake to 90% at 200 board, ease off to inside wall

corners.label: T8
corners.mistakes: lift off throttle to avoid wall

corners.label: T8
corners.line: cut all red and white curb, inside wall
corners.mistakes: hitting the wall slows you down

corners.spoken_as: the shortest line to the 300 board
corners.line: cut all curb, one set of wheels on red and white curb

corners.label: T10
corners.line: follow red and white curb on inside

corners.label: T11
corners.braking: when the curb straightens, 90% brake pressure, easing off
corners.line: turn in early, follow red and white curb
corners.exit: full throttle as early as possible
corners.mistakes: getting too far off the curb, bad exit

general_tips: hug inside wall to turn one
full throttle exit from turn one
stay on left side of track for turn two
stay close to inside wall on exit of turn two
tap brake lightly at markers for turn four
use outside as needed without hitting wall
use brake a little bit for turn 10
don't get too far off next red and white curb for turn 11
